title: Composing like cycles is a condition on tops, not a classical Mal'tsev condition
subject: Which algebraic conditions a law satisfies when its circuits compose like cycles
conclusion: Composing like cycles is incomparable with congruence permutability, n-permutability and modularity: a lift of the Z3 law is 3-permutable and modular without a Mal'tsev operation, while a shadow of it composes like cycles with neither, its fibre clone having only conjunctions and constants. What the known examples share is a polymorphism that is Mal'tsev modulo each range's maximal congruence, proved for difference laws, their lifts and suitable shadows, and conjectured for all.
